title.zh: 将西达沃省 Malita 市镇 Buhangin 描笼涯的 Basiawan 国立中学的 Malagsom 分校分离，改设为独立的 Buhangin 国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Basiawan National High School – Malagsom Extension in Barangay Buhangin, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental From the Basiawan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Buhangin National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Basiawan National High School – Malagsom Extension in Barangay Buhangin, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental From the Basiawan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Buhangin National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Malagsom của Trường Trung học Basiawan Quốc gia tại Barangay Buhangin, Đô thị Malita, Tỉnh Davao Occidental khỏi Trường Trung học Basiawan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Buhangin Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Malagsom ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Basiawan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Buhangin เทศบาล Malita จังหวัด Davao Occidental ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Basiawan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Buhangin แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Malagsom, Sekolah Menengah Basiawan Nasional di Barangay Buhangin, Kotamadya Malita, Provinsi Davao Occidental dari Sekolah Menengah Basiawan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Buhangin Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Malagsom, Sekolah Menengah Basiawan Kebangsaan di Barangay Buhangin, Perbandaran Malita, Wilayah Davao Occidental daripada Sekolah Menengah Basiawan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Buhangin Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11619_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Basiawan National High School – Malagsom Extension in Barangay Buhangin, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental is hereby separated from the Basiawan National High School and converted it into an independent national high school to be known as the Buhangin National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Basiawan National High School – Malagsom Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Buhangin National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Buhangin National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Basiawan National High School – Malagsom Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall promulgate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
